assets.name: brand-hero
assets.prompt: Photorealistic premium brand identity stationery still life, panoramic website background 3:1 ratio 2400x800 or higher. Matte black textured book upper right embossed BRAND IDENTITY SYSTEM, underneath cream BRAND GUIDELINES book, cream EV monogram card lower right, charcoal stone surface, warm directional studio light.
